Gold Valuation

Gold Valuation in Delhi — Free Jewellery & Diamond Valuation in South Extension

Free jewellery valuation in South Delhi — gold, silver and diamond valuation with Karat Meter purity, counter weighing and the day's rate, every figure shown to you.

📞 Call +91 9990780499 💬 WhatsApp Us 📍 Get Directions

What the Free Evaluation Includes

German Karat Meter purity testing, weighing at the counter in front of you, valuation at the day's market rate for gold and silver, diamond assessment (cut, colour, clarity, carat) for diamond pieces, and a line-by-line explanation of the final figure. You leave with the numbers — purity, weight and value per piece — whether or not you sell.

Valuation Without Selling

Many customers value inherited jewellery for family division, for their own records, or simply to know what they hold before deciding anything. That is a perfectly good reason to visit: the valuation is free, takes one short visit for a typical set, and carries no obligation whatsoever.

How Long Does It Take?

A typical set of items takes a short single visit. Large collections take a little longer; calling ahead on +91 9990780499 helps us keep time aside for you.

How It Works

How to Sell Your Gold in 3 Easy Steps

1

Visit Our Branch

Bring your gold, silver or diamond items and one valid photo ID to our South Extension branch — 1515, Upper Ground Floor, Wazir Nagar, South Extension Part I, Kotla Mubarakpur, New Delhi 110003. No appointment needed.

2

Get Your Gold Evaluated

We test purity on the German Karat Meter in front of you, weigh the item at the counter, and give you a fair, transparent price at the day's market rate — the full calculation explained.

3

Receive Instant Payment

Accept our offer and get paid in the same visit via cash, cheque or bank transfer, with a proper receipt. If you don't accept, you take your items back — free, no obligation.
